I consider my to self to be sucessful, at least for my age, and generally have strong moral values (don't drink, party, am a virgin, etc) and am looking for a partner who shares similar values. What makes this worse is that recently I was rejected by a girl who was everything I ever wanted, and no one harped her into lowering her standards or that she should date me cause "I am a 'good person'"
